MiniMaxH3XCanvasSolver.description: Resolve the exact canvas, frame grid, latent sizes and token count before queueing. Runtime estimates are disabled unless an explicit hardware profile is selected.

aspect_ratio.name: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.tooltip: Shape of the canvas. Width and height snap to multiples of 32.

megapixels.name: megapixels
megapixels.tooltip: Target area using ComfyUI's 1024*1024 megapixel unit.

seconds.name: seconds
seconds.tooltip: Duration at 24 fps, snapped up to H3's 17k+5 frame grid.

steps.name: steps
steps.tooltip: Used only when a hardware cost profile is selected.

cost_profile.name: cost_profile
cost_profile.tooltip: No runtime estimate is made by default. Profiles are machine-specific and must be selected explicitly.

vram_budget_gib.name: vram_budget_gib
vram_budget_gib.tooltip: Compared only with thresholds from the selected profile.

clamp_to_trained_cap.name: clamp_to_trained_cap
clamp_to_trained_cap.tooltip: Off reports the canvas ComfyUI will actually create. On shrinks over-cap requests to H3's documented trained area.

MiniMaxH3XSplitAV.description: Split an H3 AV latent into separate video and audio latents.

MiniMaxH3XJoinAV.description: Recombine video and audio latents into an H3 AV latent. Validates that both streams describe the same frame count.

strict.name: strict
strict.tooltip: Reject streams whose latent_t and audio_t disagree, or whose latent_t is off the 17k+5 grid. Turn off only when deliberately building an irregular pair.

MiniMaxH3XLatentInfo.description: Report both stream shapes, implied duration and token count.

MiniMaxH3XUpscaleVideoLatent.description: Resize the video stream of an H3 AV latent, leaving audio alone. Target pixel dimensions snap to multiples of 32.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Target pixel width; divided by 16 for the latent grid.

height.name: height
height.tooltip: Target pixel height; divided by 16 for the latent grid.

upscale_method.name: upscale_method
upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation used to resize every video frame.

MiniMaxH3XTemporalTrim.description: Shorten an H3 AV latent, keeping video and audio coherent. The result is snapped to the model's 17k+5 frame grid.

keep_seconds.name: keep_seconds
keep_seconds.tooltip: Duration to keep from the start, aligned to the frame grid.

MiniMaxH3XPromptLint.description: Check an H3 prompt against MiniMax's documented format rules. Deterministic -- no LLM, no rewriting. Passes the prompt through unchanged so it can sit inline in a workflow.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: The H3 prompt to check. It is passed through unchanged.

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: t2va/fl2va expect the three base fields; ref2va expects the six full-reference fields.

duration_seconds.name: duration_seconds
duration_seconds.tooltip: Clip duration, used to flag cut times past the end. 0 disables that check.

ref_images.name: ref_images
ref_images.tooltip: How many reference images are connected, so <Picture N> beyond that can be flagged.

ref_videos.name: ref_videos
ref_videos.tooltip: How many reference videos are connected, so <Video N> beyond that can be flagged.

ref_audios.name: ref_audios
ref_audios.tooltip: How many reference audios are connected, so <Audio N> beyond that can be flagged.

raise_on_warning.name: raise_on_warning
raise_on_warning.tooltip: Fail the workflow instead of passing the prompt through. Off by default so a lint warning never blocks a render.

MiniMaxH3XAudioReroll.description: Experimental: condition a fresh H3 sampling run on an already-generated video latent, so a new soundtrack can be produced without re-authoring the picture. The video is strongly preserved but resampled, not frozen -- use video_passthrough downstream for a bit-identical mux.

conditioning.name: conditioning
conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning from an H3 conditioning node, with the soundscape/music text changed.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: The AV latent from the run whose picture you want to keep.

video_cond_strength.name: video_cond_strength
video_cond_strength.tooltip: Noise augmentation on the video reference. 1.0 feeds it perfectly clean for maximum preservation; lower values let the picture drift. The DiT keyframe default is 0.999.

reset_audio_latent.name: reset_audio_latent
reset_audio_latent.tooltip: Start the audio stream from zeros so the sampler writes a genuinely new track. Off reuses the old audio latent and biases the result toward the original.

MiniMaxH3XNF4ModelLoader.description: Load a DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 NF4 diffusion model with BitsAndBytes.

model_name.name: model_name
model_name.tooltip: The NF4 FL2VA diffusion model, saved as minimax-h3-fl2va-nf4.safetensors in models/diffusion_models.

MiniMaxH3XNF4TextEncoderLoader.display_name: MiniMax H3 NF4 Text Encoder Loader
MiniMaxH3XNF4TextEncoderLoader.description: Load the DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL NF4 encoder.

encoder_name.name: encoder_name
encoder_name.tooltip: The NF4 Qwen3-VL text encoder, saved as minimax-h3-text-encoder-nf4.safetensors in models/text_encoders.

MiniMaxH3XNF4VideoVAELoader.display_name: MiniMax H3 NF4 Video VAE Loader
MiniMaxH3XNF4VideoVAELoader.description: Load the DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 NF4 video VAE.

vae_name.name: vae_name
vae_name.tooltip: The NF4 video VAE, saved as video_vae_nf4.safetensors in models/vae.

MiniMaxH3XNF4AudioVAELoader.display_name: MiniMax H3 NF4 Audio VAE Loader
MiniMaxH3XNF4AudioVAELoader.description: Load the DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 NF4 audio VAE.

vae_name.name: vae_name
vae_name.tooltip: The NF4 audio VAE, saved as audio_vae_nf4.safetensors in models/vae.
